summary: Contract/freeze phase only -- no runtime behavior changes, no execution capability; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Freezes Runtime Snapshot (112E) as PCAE's stable canonical read-only interface before Advisory Runtime work (113A). Frozen as the canonical read-only interface for six named consumer classes (humans, CLI -- implemented; AI agents, Telegram, REST, dashboard/UI, automation -- none implemented). Nine-domain schema frozen, transcribed directly from the real 112E implementation (runtime, registry, plugins, capabilities, health, governance, state, version, context); corrects the phase brief's own suggested principles or maturity domain against real evidence -- principles remains a field inside runtime, not a tenth top-level domain. JSON compatibility rules frozen: stable top-level keys, additive-only changes within a schema major version (grounded in 112E's own real precedent of adding context without breaking anything), removal/rename requires a major version bump, consumers must ignore unknown keys, no secrets/execution handles/mutable internal references. Deliberate versioning decision: no snapshot_schema_version field implemented this phase (would contradict the no runtime behavior changes hard boundary every prior pure contract-freeze phase has kept) -- the full field contract (name, format, compatibility/deprecation/migration rules, exact bump conditions) is frozen instead for a future implementation phase. Human output compatibility frozen (JSON is the machine contract; default output stays concise; --verbose may gain read-only sections without a version bump). Future consumers detailed for Telegram, REST, dashboard, AI agents, audit/reporting, and Advisory Runtime (113A) itself -- reading Runtime Snapshot as read-only input, never writing to it. Security rules frozen across ten forbidden categories, cross-checked against real 111B/111C/111D/112E adversarial-test evidence. Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_CONTRACT.md, docs/PHASE_112_RUNTIME_SNAPSHOT_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md. 125 new tests (tests/test_runtime_snapshot_contract.py), including a direct cross-check of the frozen schema against the real CLI's current JSON output.
